result.brief: Two-storey steel-framed office block for Lekki Gardens Holdings at Lekki, Lagos, with pad/strip foundations and 127mm ground slab, W-shape columns/beams with bar joists supporting 38mm metal deck plus 64mm topping at upper floor. External walls are 152mm metal stud with plywood sheathing, 90mm facing brickwork outside and plasterboard inside, with mainly drywall partitions, acoustic ceilings, fixed glazing and flush doors. Roof is mainly standing-seam metal with a small EPDM area; services include chiller/AHUs, full lighting fit-out and a hydraulic lift, but the model shows no substructure excavation, finishes, sanitary ware, distribution services or external works.

facts.frame: structural steel frame with bar joists and metal deck

result.review_summary: The takeoff measures the frame, envelope shell, partitions, ceilings, doors/windows and major plant well, but quantities for stairs and ground-slab edges look unreliable and over 450 flow terminals are held unmeasured. The BOQ cannot be trusted until door types, missing sanitary/distribution services, finishes and the roof build-up are resolved, and the provisional site, substructure and external works items below are added.
